changes.title: Mushroom halo flat
items: Mushrooms now cast a softer, wider light by default, with a fainter colour pool.
The light around each mushroom now lies flat on the ground, so it is no longer cut off at the bottom.

changes.title: Friendly area stump
items: Once you finish a legend's quest, the creatures in its area show as friends on its stump, so you can cast the soundsystem spell there.

changes.title: First hat pin
items: On a fresh game's first morning, her hat shows where it lies on the first hat spawn point, and the hat pointer leads there instead of to the old hats area.
A newly found hat's pointer leads to the spawn point it lies on, and goes once she is close enough to take it.

changes.title: Speech no box
items: Speech emoji float on their own, without the white box round them.

changes.title: Combat waiting space
items: Waiting creatures move farther around the fight, with deliberate close passes and room to pursue wounded animals.
Turning lunges warn with an outward wave of red dots that flares as they prepare to attack.
